neet_phy_u02_t10_1.working: v = dr/dt = 3i + 4t j. At t = 2 s this gives v = 3i + 8j m/s.

neet_phy_u02_t10_2.working: x = 4t and y = (1/2)(2)t^2 = t^2. Substituting t = x/4 gives y = x^2/16.

neet_phy_u02_t10_4.working: A is true: in curved motion, acceleration need not be along velocity. R is false: the perpendicular component changes direction only, not speed.

neet_phy_u02_t10_5.working: v = 2i + (4-2t)j, so at t = 2 s, v = 2i, which is not zero; I is false. a = -2j, which is perpendicular to 2i; II is true.
